targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: The V3-EXQ substrate-readiness family (14 runs, 2026-04-21 to 2026-06-04) decides PASS on PLUMBING assertions in 12 of 14 cases -- is-not-None, shape equality, isfinite, exact arithmetic identity against a hand-written table, counter increments -- completing in 0.684-2.539s with no episodic loop, while every driver hardcodes evidence_direction = 'supports' if all_pass else 'weakens' on its tagged claims. That authoring template is real and worth recording. THE EVIDENCE-INTEGRITY ALARM IS WITHDRAWN, however, and this is stated plainly because an earlier draft of this autopsy asserted it: the containment is COMPLETE, not partial. direction_counts and source_counts are built from entries with scoring_excluded ALREADY FILTERED, so the readiness runs reach no headline count. The worked case an earlier draft cited as the sharpest harm is in fact the refutation: MECH-313's 5 supports are its five LITERATURE entries (diayn/eysenbach2018, sac/haarnoja2018, dvd/parkerholder2020, tervo2014, astonjones2005), its source_counts read {experimental: 0, literature: 6}, and both the 544 and 544a rows carry scoring_excluded=diagnostic_probe. Nothing from this family weights any claim. Governance had additionally ALREADY applied the remedy: 545x2, 546x2 and 547 were reclassified non_contributory in the 2026-05-11 walk (d72741c9e0), 542a x3 were authored non_contributory, and 613/617/639 carry no claim_ids -- leaving a claim-bearing supports residue of exactly THREE manifests (542, 544, 544a), i.e. hygiene, not a class-level defect. WHAT DOES SURVIVE, and is the durable finding: all 14 fail the Experimental Recording Standard always-core -- substrate_hash, substrate_commit and config are absent from every one, because each driver calls write_flat_manifest with config=manifest.get('config') where no 'config' key was ever set, making both provenance kwargs None by construction. seeds is absent from 13 of 14. None of the 14 carries interpretation/preconditions[]/criteria_non_degenerate, so the indexer's adjudication flag could never fire on the class.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: All 14 substrate-readiness drivers call write_flat_manifest(..., config=manifest.get("config"), seeds=None) where no "config" key was ever set, so both provenance kwargs are None BY CONSTRUCTION and every manifest in the family lacks substrate_hash, substrate_commit and config (seeds absent in 13/14). Fix the shared authoring template so readiness runs stamp the Experimental Recording Standard always-core via experiments/_lib/manifest_core.stamp_recording_core(...). Secondary, lower priority: these drivers hardcode evidence_direction = "supports" if all_pass else "weakens" on tagged claims; a readiness gate should emit non_contributory (or no direction) rather than a claim-bearing one. NOTE the evidence-weighting alarm is WITHDRAWN -- scoring exclusion contains it completely -- so this second item is hygiene, not an integrity fix.

learning_extracted: A readiness gate that hardcodes evidence_direction from its own all_pass flag looks like an evidence-integrity problem and is not one here: scoring_excluded filtering is applied upstream of direction_counts, so the containment is complete.
Check WHICH entries produce a headline count before calling it exposure -- MECH-313's 5 supports are literature, not the plumbing gates that were suspected.

The durable defect in this family is the recording standard, not the evidence weighting: 14/14 lack substrate_hash/substrate_commit/config because write_flat_manifest is called with a config key that was never set.
Governance had already reclassified most of this family in the 2026-05-11 walk; the residue is 3 manifests, so the correct output is hygiene, not a class-level alarm.

cluster_pattern.shape: 14 substrate-readiness diagnostics, 12 of which decide PASS on plumbing assertions, all emitting a hardcoded claim-bearing evidence_direction
cluster_pattern.structural_property: One shared authoring template, not 14 independent defects: every driver calls write_flat_manifest with config/seeds unset by construction (the durable finding, 14/14), and every one hardcodes evidence_direction from all_pass (real, but fully contained by scoring exclusion, and already remediated by governance for all but 3 manifests). Two runs are genuine exceptions on the science: 613 UC3/UC4, and weakly 542/542a UC4. The 545/546/542a duplicates are re-emissions, not replicates -- 0 of 37 and 0 of 82 metric leaves differ.
